scenario.name: Administrative Unit
scenario.title: At the administrative unit (upravna enota)
scenario.character: a brisk but courteous clerk (uslužbenka) at a Slovenian administrative unit (upravna enota) in Ljubljana
scenario.setup: You are a brisk but courteous civil servant at the counter of a Slovenian administrative unit (upravna enota) in Ljubljana. A foreigner who lives here comes to submit an application for a residence-and-work permit — you check their appointment, passport and documents, then handle the fee, the timing and how they will be notified. Keep it standard and formal (vi, knjižni).
scenario.opening: Dober dan. Kako vam lahko pomagam?

objectives.label: State your purpose
objectives.descriptorEN: Say you'd like to submit an application with 'Rad bi oddal vlogo za dovoljenje za prebivanje in delo.'

objectives.label: Give your appointment status
objectives.descriptorEN: Say you have an appointment ('naročen sem ob deveti uri') or that you don't ('Ne, nimam termina.').

objectives.label: Present your documents
objectives.descriptorEN: Hand over your passport ('Izvolite, tukaj je moj potni list.') and name your documents (pogodba o zaposlitvi, fotografija, dokazilo o zdravstvenem zavarovanju, obrazec).

objectives.label: Handle the missing document
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask where to get the missing proof ('Kje ga lahko dobim?') or offer your rental agreement ('Imam najemno pogodbo. Ali je to dovolj?').

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan. Kako vam lahko pomagam?
n1.en: Good day. How can I help you?
n1.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Dober dan. Kako vam lahko pomagam?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi oddal vlogo za dovoljenje za prebivanje in delo.
c1a.en: Good day. I'd like to submit an application for a residence and work permit.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi oddal vlogo za dovoljenje za prebivanje.
c1b.en: Good day. I'd like to submit an application for a residence permit.

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.sl: Da, naročen sem ob deveti uri.
c2a.en: Yes, I have an appointment at nine o'clock.

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.sl: Ne, nimam termina. Ali je to problem?
c2b.en: No, I don't have an appointment. Is that a problem?

n3.speaker: npc
n3.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Prosim za vaš potni list.

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.sl: Izvolite, tukaj je moj potni list.
c3b.en: Here you are, this is my passport.

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Hvala. Ali imate vse potrebne dokumente?
n4.en: Thank you. Do you have all the required documents?
n4.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Hvala. Ali imate vse potrebne dokumente?

c4a.speaker: client
c4a.sl: Mislim, da jih imam. Tukaj so pogodba o zaposlitvi, fotografija in dokazilo o zdravstvenem zavarovanju.
c4a.en: I think I have them. Here are the employment contract, a photograph and proof of health insurance.

c4b.speaker: client
c4b.sl: Da, tukaj so vsi dokumenti in izpolnjen obrazec.
c4b.en: Yes, here are all the documents and the completed form.

n5.speaker: npc
n5.sl: Samo trenutek, prosim. Preverila bom dokumente. Dokumenti so skoraj popolni, vendar manjka potrdilo o prijavi prebivališča.
n5.en: One moment, please. I'll check the documents. The documents are almost complete, but proof of residence registration is missing.
n5.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Samo trenutek, prosim. Preverila bom dokumente. Dokumenti so skoraj popolni, vendar manjka potrdilo o prijavi prebivališča.

c5b.speaker: client
c5b.sl: Imam najemno pogodbo. Ali je to dovolj?
c5b.en: I have a rental agreement. Is that enough?

n6a.speaker: npc
n6a.sl: Če že živite v Sloveniji, ga lahko uredite tukaj.
n6a.en: If you already live in Slovenia, you can arrange it here.
n6a.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Če že živite v Sloveniji, ga lahko uredite tukaj.

n6b.speaker: npc
n6b.en: Yes, a rental agreement will be enough.
n6b.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Da, najemna pogodba bo dovolj.

n7.speaker: npc
n7.sl: Ko boste imeli vse dokumente, lahko oddate vlogo tukaj. Nasvidenje.
n7.en: Once you have all the documents, you can submit the application here. Goodbye.
n7.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Ko boste imeli vse dokumente, lahko oddate vlogo tukaj. Nasvidenje.

c7b.speaker: client
c7b.en: Thank you very much for your help. Goodbye.

new.predictableError: leaving the noun nominative ('oddal vloga') instead of the accusative 'vlogo'
dropping 'za' or genitivizing it ('dovoljenje prebivanja') on the model of English 'residence permit'

new.gloss: I have an appointment / I'm booked in
new.predictableError: translating 'I have an appointment' literally as 'imam termin', or dropping the masculine ending ('naročena sem')
failing to put it in the genitive after 'nimam' ('nimam termin' instead of 'nimam termina')
adding an animate accusative -a ('potni lista'); it is inanimate, so accusative = nominative 'potni list'
using the wrong preposition/case ('pogodba za zaposlitev') instead of the locative 'o zaposlitvi'
substituting the English-shaped 'foto' / 'slika', or misdeclining it in the list
leaving the complement nominative ('o zdravstveno zavarovanje') instead of the locative 'o zdravstvenem zavarovanju'
confusing it with 'vloga', or dropping the masculine agreement in 'izpolnjen obrazec'
leaving it nominative after 'imam' ('imam najemna pogodba') instead of the accusative 'najemno pogodbo'
omitting 'to' ('Ali je dovolj?') or a literal word order 'Je to dovolj?'; the natural yes/no check keeps 'Ali je to dovolj?'

objectives.label: Ask how long it takes
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask the procedure's duration with 'Koliko časa traja postopek?' or 'Kako dolgo bo trajalo?'

objectives.label: Ask how you'll be notified
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask how you'll learn the permit is ready ('Kako bom izvedel, da je dovoljenje pripravljeno?' / 'kako me boste obvestili?').

objectives.label: Ask the fee
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask the administrative fee with 'Koliko znaša upravna taksa?' (or 'Koliko stane ...?').

objectives.label: Choose how to pay
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask to pay by card ('Ali lahko plačam s kartico?') or in cash ('Ali lahko plačam z gotovino?').

objectives.label: Thank and close
objectives.descriptorEN: Thank her for her help ('Hvala za pomoč.') and close with 'Nasvidenje.'

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan. Vašo vlogo sem sprejela. Imate še kakšno vprašanje?
n1.en: Good day. I've accepted your application. Do you have any more questions?
n1.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Dober dan. Vašo vlogo sem sprejela. Imate še kakšno vprašanje?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.en: Yes. How long does the procedure take?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.en: Yes. How long will it take?

n2.speaker: npc
n2.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Običajno približno en mesec.

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.sl: Kako bom izvedel, da je dovoljenje pripravljeno?
c2a.en: How will I know when the permit is ready?

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.en: And how will you notify me?

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Poslali vam bomo obvestilo po pošti ali po elektronski pošti.
n3.en: We'll send you a notification by mail or by email.
n3.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Poslali vam bomo obvestilo po pošti ali po elektronski pošti.

c3a.speaker: client
c3a.sl: V redu, hvala. Koliko znaša upravna taksa?
c3a.en: Alright, thank you. How much is the administrative fee?

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.en: I understand. How much does the administrative fee cost?

n4.speaker: npc
n4.en: The administrative fee is seventy euros.
n4.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Upravna taksa znaša sedemdeset evrov.

n5a.speaker: npc
n5a.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Seveda, sprejemamo kartice.

n5b.speaker: npc
n5b.en: Of course, we accept cash too.
n5b.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Seveda, sprejemamo tudi gotovino.

n6.speaker: npc
n6.sl: Ni za kaj. Vse bo pripravljeno v približno enem mesecu. Nasvidenje in lep dan!
n6.en: You're welcome. Everything will be ready in about a month. Goodbye and have a nice day!
n6.deliverySL: [brisk, courteous civil servant] Ni za kaj. Vse bo pripravljeno v približno enem mesecu. Nasvidenje in lep dan!

new.predictableError: using nominative 'čas' instead of the genitive 'časa' after 'koliko' ('koliko časa', not 'koliko čas')
calquing 'how long' as the adjective 'kako dolg' instead of the adverb 'dolgo'
keeping the fleeting -e- when declining (genitive is 'postopka', not 'postopeka')
treating the neuter noun as masculine ('ta dovoljenje' instead of 'to dovoljenje')
using the imperfective 'obveščati' for the one-off future act, or the wrong object case ('me boste obvestili')
failing to agree the feminine adjective ('upravni/upravno taksa' instead of 'upravna taksa')
conjugating as 'koliko znaši', or confusing it with 'koliko stane'; the amount stays a nominative subject
regularising the 1sg as 'razumam' instead of 'razumem'
using the dative 'hvala pomoči' (calquing 'thanks to') instead of 'za' + accusative 'pomoč'
